messages.subject: Update to v0.60.5
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I have made a bugfix update to v0.60.5

There was a bug in "dti_create_mats" when "sub.thresh = 0" (i.e., if you didn't want to impose a constraint on the number of subjects in a group exceeding the "mat.thresh" for an edge to be included). This has now been fixed.
There are also more weighted graph calculations performed by "set.brainGraph.attributes".

You can see the changes on Github <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/fabf5f5c3d67566bdea5c732561061025aab2fcb?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>

Chris
